title: Figures 16-17 (20660): road map of lights track toward Baird and depiction of amber lights
description: Figure 16 is a road map of north-central Texas (Breckenridge, Eastland, Cisco, Ranger, Stephenville) with a red dashed arrow from "First Sighted" near Morgan Mill westward to "Object Disappeared" near Baird, with a 20 mi / 20 km scale; caption: "Figure 16 (20660) Light in the Texas Sky depiction of lights track." Figure 17 is a digital depiction of four amber lights in a row with a small red light beneath, annotated "Amber lights pulsing in sequence," "Small light flashing red/white" and "11/18/09 Depiction"; its caption credits a redacted (1843(a)(2)) person "of Lights in the Texas Sky."
